newsitem.title: USA: Zalm doubts talk of Camdessus as EU central banker.
newsitem.headline: Zalm doubts talk of Camdessus as EU central banker.

text.p: Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said on Sunday he thought there was no truth to speculation of a deal to appoint IMF chief Michel Camdessus as the first head of the future European Central Bank.
"I haven't heard of it. I don't think it's true," he told reporters on the sidelines of the semiannual meeting of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank.
Newspapers had speculated about a secret deal between France and Germany whereby Camdessus, a Frenchman, would head the ECB while a German would take over his post as managing director of the IMF.
Dutch Central Bank head Wim Duisenberg, due to take over this year as head of the ECB's forerunner, the European Monetary Institute, is tipped as favorite for the ECB job.
But France has said it should not be automatically assumed that Duisenberg will move from the EMI to the ECB, raising speculation it might want the job at the central bank to go to a Frenchman.
Camdessus has declined comment on the speculation.
